newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tribasa bidding in Argentina, Bolivia.
newsitem.headline: Tribasa bidding in Argentina, Bolivia.

text.p: Mexican construction company Grupo Tribasa expects decisions soon on infrastructure projects in Argentina and Bolivia, a company director said on Monday.
In Argentina, Tribasa is bidding for the privatization of the Buenos Aires airport and in Bolivia is vying for the concession of a 80 km freeway, the director, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
He said the company's prospects for winning both concessions are very favorable and that Tribasa's technical and economic were competitive.
"The Buenos Aires project should be decided in about 15 days," he said. "In Bolivia, the freeway is already built, but it needs to be patched up."
The source declined to detail investment requirements.
In South America, Tribasa holds three freeway concessions in Chile, for a total value of more than $650 million. It also holds a freeway concession in Ecuador worth about $30 million.
